name: Astorga to Foncebadón

from.name: Astorga
from.source: photon.komoot.io relation/347413 place=town (point checked with Nominatim reverse geocoding: inside the town)

notes: Walking order checked from the coordinates: Murias de Rechivaldo, Santa Catalina de Somoza, El Ganso, then Rabanal del Camino, which comes BEFORE Foncebadón (about 5 km before, straight line); all vias lie strictly between Astorga and Foncebadón. El Ganso: Photon lists several localities with this name in Castilla y León; the one used is in the municipality of Brazuelo, between Santa Catalina and Rabanal. Astorga is the relation 347413 (place=town); reverse geocoding puts the point on Plaza Santocildes in the town centre. Foncebadón is a hamlet node at the foot of the climb; Cruz de Ferro is 1.6 km beyond it (stage 24). Common practice: many guides end the day at Rabanal del Camino.
